column1: Phase 2 clinical trial on Letrozole ISM® vs Femara®, both medicines being combined with CDK 4/6 inhibitors, in post-
menopausal women with advanced breast cancer and, subsequently, a Phase 3 trial in women with early breast cancer.
This clinical path would probably last more than ten years and would require an investment much higher than initially
planned before the dossier to apply for marketing authorisation for the product could be filed. As a result, the company
has decided to place the clinical development of annual Letrozole ISM® on hold for the time being.
